scope: Read-only cross-device check of boundary geometry, contact HFS/SG, and electron quasi-Fermi feedback
claim_policy: The LDMOS source worktree is read-only and dirty; M38 is a qualified snapshot, not frozen final LDMOS evidence.
A shared dominant quasi-Fermi feedback pathway does not imply identical direct contact-HFS behavior across devices.
AverageBox residual improvement is not called sufficient unless the self-consistent current also closes.
No LDMOS or SimpleMOS production default is changed by this crosscheck.
